question: What was notable about the colossal squid filmed in 2025, and where was it seen?
text:
It was the **first confirmed footage of a colossal squid alive in its natural habitat**, a century after the species was first identified. Despite its name, the squid was a juvenile only about 30 centimeters (1 foot) long. ([schmidtocean.org](https://schmidtocean.org/first-colossal-squid-footage/?ck_subscriber_id=2538359195&utm_source=openai))

It was filmed on March 9, 2025, about 600 meters (2,000 feet) below the surface off the **South Sandwich Islands** in the South Atlantic Ocean. ([schmidtocean.org](https://schmidtocean.org/first-colossal-squid-footage/?ck_subscriber_id=2538359195&utm_source=openai))
